summary: Tested the new Admin SEO Dashboard (Google Search Console) feature end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass covering auth guards, payload validation, smoke-test, dashboard error path, and delete. Frontend: SEO tab loads inside /admin, all required data-testids present, save flow works against a fake service-account JSON, smoke error & dashboard error are displayed gracefully (no traceback), and delete clears credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3270 — _gsc_smoke_test catches all Exception and stringifies; should consider logging at WARN so admins can see full stack in backend logs in addition to the trimmed string returned to client.

server.py:3296-3305 — Error classification by substring match on 'msg' is fragile; an upstream error containing '403' anywhere (e.g. inside a URL) could mis-route. Prefer inspecting the HttpError.resp.status from googleapiclient.errors.HttpError.
server.py:3273 — _gsc_query_dashboard imports google libs lazily inside the function. Good for cold-start, but a one-time module check at startup would surface missing deps earlier.
Admin.jsx:1441-1801 — File is ~1800 lines combining many admin tabs; consider splitting each tab (SEODashboardTab, etc.) into separate files per the 700-line guideline.
Admin.jsx:1515 — After save, saJson is wiped from local state (good for security), but credsConfigured stays true so the textarea becomes inaccessible until delete — fine, just worth noting in docs.
models.py:232-234 — gsc_service_account_json is stored verbatim in MongoDB; consider field-level encryption at rest since the private_key is sensitive.
seed_data_creation: None. A TEST_seo_user@example.com regular user is registered for the non-admin auth guard test; safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEO Dashboard tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_seo.py and use a fake-but-well-shaped service-account JSON. The dashboard endpoint correctly returns HTTP 500 with detail 'GSC query failed: ...' for fake creds (no traceback), which is the intended graceful-failure path. A true 200 dashboard fetch cannot be tested without real Google credentials. Frontend uses localStorage key 'token' for auth (NOT 'access_token') — to test admin UI quickly, POST /api/auth/login then localStorage.setItem('token', data.token) before navigating to /admin.

verification_evidence.frontend_ui: SEO tab opens, all 4 testids (seo-site-url-input, seo-sa-file, seo-sa-json, seo-save-creds-btn) found; fake SA save returns smoke_test_error 'GSC query failed: Service account info was not in the expected format, missing fields token_uri.' displayed in amber banner; dashboard section shows same error gracefully; malformed JSON triggers toast 'service_account_json is not valid JSON'; delete returns 200.
